selection.scope: StageB approached near-ball CALIBRATION ONLY; not production recovery, not task success

body.role: 50 Hz locomotion/control IMU; separate from head_imu.stream
body.transport: Dynamixel combined sync_read with servo feedback
body.decoder: component-wise median3 gyro/gravity, unfiltered quaternion; ready after25 live quaternion reads
body.pipeline_delay_origin: Experiment assumption only: robotd reads, infers and applies in the same50Hz loop; no fixed post-read20ms queue is established by upstream source
body.pipeline_delay_default_scope: Zero added queue follows the same-tick source schedule, not a measured zero bus/inference time; historical20ms is an explicit stress case
body.median_phase_note: Component-wise median3 already contributes approximately one50Hz tick of phase lag on monotonic signals; its delay must not be counted again as transport
assumptions: 120 Hz virtual internal fusion rate is not confirmed body firmware configuration
gyro bias/noise and acceleration noise are experiment inputs
power-board translation is unknown; trunk origin is a parameterized approximation
Additional post-read pipeline delay is unknown; zero added queue is a baseline and20ms remains an explicit historical stress setting, neither is a measured bus/inference duration

fusion_initialization.invalid_output: orientation_valid=false and quat=null until a continuous stationary gravity window
fusion_initialization.assumption: near-gravity magnitude, low gyro and stable acceleration are evidence for approximate rest; sustained constant linear acceleration remains unobservable without another sensor

body.virtual_sensor_acceleration: two finite differences of the configured rigidly-mounted sensor point at200Hz
body.warmup: first two physics updates establish derivatives without invented acceleration
body.interpretation: Clipping flags and finite-range integration error are preserved; no truth orientation correction.

head.simulation_model: biased/noisy local gyro and specific force; lightweight complementary tilt fusion
head.orientation_reference: gravity-aligned local frame, yaw initialized at zero and integrated from gyro

initialization.invalid_output: orientation_valid=false and quat=null until a continuous stationary gravity window
initialization.assumption: near-gravity magnitude, low gyro and stable acceleration are evidence for approximate rest; sustained constant linear acceleration remains unobservable without another sensor

head.truth_boundary: World kinematics are used only inside sensor synthesis, never exported as task localization

processing_shared_imu_transport.limitation: Two sensor bodies in env_0; not a vectorized1024-env training implementation. No rendering, contact, encoder or BAM synchronization is combined here.

camera.optics_origin: course sensitivity experiment; not alpha calibration and not measured Beta optics

tof.close_range_model: Conservative course slant-range filter; official kinematics also filters near points. This does not reproduce the chip's target-status firmware
